name: maps
doc:
maps: generic helpers over the builtin map[K]V. Builtin maps have
no defined iteration order, so Keys and Values come back in an
unspecified order; SortedKeys sorts them.

items.name: Clone
items.signature: func Clone<K: Comparable, V>(m map[K]V) map[K]V

items.name: Copy
items.signature: func Copy<K: Comparable, V>(dst map[K]V, src map[K]V)
items.doc: Copies every entry of src into dst (overwriting equal keys).
items.summary: Copies every entry of src into dst (overwriting equal keys).

items.name: DeleteFunc
items.signature: func DeleteFunc<K: Comparable, V>(m map[K]V, del func(K, V) bool)
items.doc: Deletes the entries satisfying del, in place.
items.summary: Deletes the entries satisfying del, in place.

items.name: Equal
items.signature: func Equal<K: Comparable, V: Comparable>(a map[K]V, b map[K]V) bool
items.doc: True if a and b have the same keys with equal values.
items.summary: True if a and b have the same keys with equal values.

items.name: EqualFunc
items.signature: func EqualFunc<K: Comparable, V, W>(a map[K]V, b map[K]W, eq func(V, W) bool) bool
items.doc: Like Equal with a value equality function.
items.summary: Like Equal with a value equality function.

items.name: Filter
items.signature: func Filter<K: Comparable, V>(m map[K]V, keep func(K, V) bool) map[K]V
items.doc: A new map with the entries satisfying keep.
items.summary: A new map with the entries satisfying keep.

examples.name: ExampleFilter

items.name: Invert
items.signature: func Invert<K: Ordered, V: Comparable>(m map[K]V) map[V]K
items.doc:
A new map from value to key. With duplicate values, the entry of the
largest key wins when K is Ordered (deterministic); see InvertAll.
items.summary: A new map from value to key.

items.name: InvertAll
items.signature: func InvertAll<K: Ordered, V: Comparable>(m map[K]V) map[V][]K
items.doc: A new map from value to all its keys (sorted ascending).
items.summary: A new map from value to all its keys (sorted ascending).

items.name: MapValues
items.signature: func MapValues<K: Comparable, V, W>(m map[K]V, f func(V) W) map[K]W
items.doc: A new map with f applied to every value.
items.summary: A new map with f applied to every value.

items.name: Merge
items.signature: func Merge<K: Comparable, V>(a map[K]V, b map[K]V) map[K]V
items.doc: A new map with the entries of a and then b (b wins on equal keys).
items.summary: A new map with the entries of a and then b (b wins on equal keys).

examples.name: ExampleMerge

items.name: SortedKeys
items.doc: The keys of m, sorted ascending.
items.summary: The keys of m, sorted ascending.

items.name: SortedValues
items.doc: The values of m in ascending key order.
items.summary: The values of m in ascending key order.

examples.name: ExampleSortedValues
